en.title: The Glass Specimen Room
en.premise: Beauty is only perfected once it has died. Armed with a broken pocket watch that can halt time, a man transforms his loved ones into jewels in his pursuit of eternal beauty. But deep within their crystallized bodies, their consciousnesses continue to scream.

zh.title: 玻璃标本室
zh.premise: 美，唯有在死亡之时方能臻于完美。一名男子得到了能够停止时间的破损怀表，为了追求永恒之美，他将所爱之人化作宝石。然而，在那些结晶化的躯壳之中，唯有他们的意识仍在无尽地尖叫。
